amendments.body: Build is currently broken. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1454`, `:1473`, and `:1485` add second definitions of `density_repro_factor`, `tan_repro_factor`, and `no2_repro_factor`, which already exist at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1508`, `:1526`, and `:1537`. `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:7` also imports `dominant_repro_suppression` while `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:375` redefines it locally. `cargo test -p tank_core snapshot` fails with E0428/E0255, so this patch does not compile.
amendments.rationale: This is a release-blocking regression: the crate cannot be built or tested.

amendments.body: The new snapshot-side `dominant_repro_suppression` implementation in `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:375` does not match the real reproduction model. It omits the molt-stress factor used by `update_reproductive_readiness` at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:679`, folds TAN and nitrite into a generic `chemistry` bucket instead of the separate `tan`/`nitrite` diagnostics in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1572` and `:1574`, and uses different suppression curves/floors than the shared helper starting at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1548`. Even after the compile error is fixed, `repro_dominant_suppression` can disagree with the actual readiness calculation and mislead debugging.
amendments.rationale: This field is supposed to explain why reproduction is suppressed; divergent math makes the new diagnostic unreliable.

payload.summary: Read the changed shrimp and snapshot implementations end-to-end and ran a targeted build/test command. I found one blocking compile regression from duplicate helper definitions plus a second correctness issue where the new snapshot suppression diagnostic diverges from the actual reproduction model.
